# TUI golden frames

Byte-for-byte captures from `apps/tui/test/golden.test.tsx` (`FakeApiHandle`, frozen
clock, two committed geometries: `100x30` and `140x40`). These are the same frames CI
diffs on every PR, so they can never go stale silently — a visual change that isn't
reflected here fails `pnpm --filter @patches/tui test -- golden` first.
